United by a shared purpose, we’re building a smarter, trustful and more connected world.

Sounds like your kind of place? 

Your job 

The ITU Security Officer is responsible for defining, implementing and monitoring information security measures within the organization. Acting as a trusted security advisor, the role bridges technical teams, business stakeholders and security governance. He/she reports to the CoE lead des FSP architects & experts

Key Responsibilities

• Contribute to the information security strategy

You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

• JavaScript

• Unit & integration testing

• CI/CD pipelines

• Microsoft Azure

• Kubernetes

• Docker

• AKS

• WPF (XAML) is a plus

• Problem-solving

• Rigorous methodology

Qualifications

• Master's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field is a plus

Conforma is a Contract Manufacturing Organisation (CMO) specialising in the manufacturing of non-sterile liquid and semi-solid pharmaceutical and medical device products, including solutions, syrups, gels and creams.
 

As we expand internationally, we are looking for an Outbound Sales professional to identify new opportunities, build a qualified prospect pipeline and support our commercial visibility.
 

This is a 
 hands-on commercial role 
combining market research, lead generation, outbound sales and business development. You will identify companies whose products could potentially be manufactured by Conforma, assess whether they have internal manufacturing capabilities, and identify the right people to approach.
 

You will help us turn market intelligence into concrete commercial opportunities.
 

Your responsibilities
 

· Identify and map potential customers across Europe and, subsequently, international markets
 

· Research companies, product portfolios and manufacturing capabilities to identify potential outsourcing and contract manufacturing opportunities
 

· Build and maintain a structured, high-quality prospect database and prioritise opportunities based on commercial potential
 

· Identify relevant decision-makers and map professional contact details
 

· Use online research, professional networks, databases and direct telephone contact to obtain or verify information and establish the right point of contact
 

· Support targeted outbound campaigns and follow up qualified leads together with the Business Development team
 

· Support the organisation and commercial follow-up of relevant international trade fairs and industry events
 

· Help keep Conforma's LinkedIn company page professional, current and engaging by contributing to relevant posts and content

We are looking for someone who is curious, commercially minded, proactive and not afraid to pick up the phone. You enjoy investigating companies, finding information that is not immediately available and turning that information into actionable opportunities.
 

· A higher education degree or equivalent experience in business, marketing, life sciences, pharmaceutical sciences, international business or a related field
 

· Excellent written and spoken Dutch & English is essential
 

· Strong research, analytical and organisational skills
 

· Excellent communication skills and the confidence to speak with people you have never contacted before
 

· A commercial mindset and genuine interest in business development
 

· Persistence and the ability to professionally obtain information
 

· Good digital and online research skills
 

· The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with the Business Development team
 

What makes this role different?
 

This is not a traditional telesales position. You will not simply work through a predefined list of leads. You will help build our international market map from the ground up: identifying potential customers, understanding their products and manufacturing footprint, discovering where outsourcing opportunities may exist and determining who we should speak to.
 

Your work will directly contribute to Conforma's international growth and give you the opportunity to build a broad network within the pharmaceutical and medical device industries.

This international company specializes in the production and supply of plastic components for the automotive industry, including injection-moulded parts for vehicles.

Jobomschrijving

For an international manufacturing company in the Aalst region, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to help ensure the optimal operation of an advanced machine park.

You will work in a two-shift system:
	
• Early shift: 06:00–14:00	
• Late shift: 14:00–22:00
As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for maintaining, repairing and improving industrial machinery and technical installations. Thanks to your expertise, production processes remain reliable and downtime is kept to a minimum.

Your tasks and responsibilities
	
• Carrying out preventive maintenance on production machines, injection moulding machines and auxiliary equipment.	
• Troubleshooting electrical, mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic faults.	
• Carrying out corrective repairs in the event of technical breakdowns.	
• Analysing faults and looking for sustainable solutions.	
• Independently carrying out small technical projects and improvements.	
• Actively contributing to optimizations aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of the machine park.	
• Working closely with the production department to minimize downtime.	
• Working according to applicable safety, quality and environmental standards.	
• Helping to maintain a clean, safe and well-organized working environment.

You have a strong technical background and enjoy working hands-on.

In addition, you have:
	
• A technical qualification in Electromechanics, Electrical Engineering, Automation or a similar technical field, or equivalent practical experience.	
• Experience in the maintenance and repair of industrial machinery.	
• Knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance in a production environment.	
• Basic knowledge of PLC control systems is an advantage. If you have limited experience in this area, you will have the opportunity to develop this knowledge internally.	
• Experience with injection moulding machines is an advantage, but is not required.	
• A good command of Dutch.	
• The ability to understand technical documentation in English and/or German.	
• Strong analytical skills and a solution-oriented approach.	
• A hands-on mentality and a strong sense of responsibility.	
• Good team spirit combined with the ability to carry out interventions independently.
